answer:
## UG Admission Process at LDCE

**LDCE** (Lalbhai Dalpatbhai College of Engineering) offers admission to undergraduate (4-year B.E.) programmes through the **ACPC (Admission Committee for Professional Courses)**, Government of Gujarat.

### Fresh Entry (Class 12)
1. Clear **JEE Main** or pass **GUJCET** (Gujarat Common Entrance Test)
2. Register on the ACPC portal and fill branch/college choices
3. Attend seat allotment rounds (merit-based, reservation norms apply)
4. Report to LDCE with required documents and pay fees

### Lateral Entry / D2D (Diploma to Degree)
- Diploma holders can seek direct second-year (D2D) admission through ACPC
- Based on diploma results; DDCET score required for some seats

> **Please verify current dates and cut-offs on the official ACPC portal and LDCE website for the latest cycle.**

📎 [LDCE UG Admissions](https://ldce.ac.in/admissions/ug-programs) | [ACPC Gujarat](https://acpc.gujarat.gov.in)

## Eligibility Criteria for UG Admission

- Passed **10+2 (HSC)** or equivalent with **Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM)**
- Minimum aggregate marks in PCM: please check the official ACPC/LDCE guidelines for the current academic year
- Valid **JEE Main** score **or** **GUJCET** score is typically required
- Indian nationals and NRI/OCI categories have separate quotas

> ⚠️ **Exact minimum percentage cut-offs vary by academic year and category. Please verify on the ACPC portal.**

## Seat Reservation Policy

LDCE follows the **Government of Gujarat reservation policy** applicable to government-aided engineering colleges:

- **SC (Scheduled Caste)**: Reserved seats as per state norms
- **ST (Scheduled Tribe)**: Reserved seats as per state norms
- **SEBC/OBC**: Reserved seats as per state norms
- **EWS (Economically Weaker Section)**: Reserved seats as per state norms
- **NRI / OCI / PIO**: Separate quota managed through ACPC

> ⚠️ **Exact percentages and seat counts change each academic year. Please verify with the ACPC seat matrix for the current cycle.**

The **Computer Engineering (CE/CSE)** department at LDCE is one of the most sought-after programmes. It covers core areas of software engineering, algorithms, data structures, computer networks, databases, operating systems, and emerging fields such as AI/ML, cloud computing, and cybersecurity.

- Well-equipped computer labs and research facilities

- Strong industry ties and campus placement record

> For the latest information on intake, syllabus, faculty, and fees, please visit the official department page.

## Academic Curriculum at LDCE

B.E. programmes at LDCE are **4-year (8-semester)** degrees affiliated with **Gujarat Technological University (GTU)**.

**Structure:**
- **Semester 1 & 2**: Common for all branches (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, English, basic engineering)
- **Semester 3 onwards**: Branch-specific core subjects, labs, and electives
- **Semester 7 & 8** (typically): Major projects, electives, and industrial training

> The detailed semester-wise syllabus for each branch is published by GTU. Please refer to the GTU syllabus portal or your department for the current curriculum.

📎 [LDCE Academics](https://ldce.ac.in/admissions/ug-programs) | [Academic Calendar](https://ldce.ac.in/admissions/calendar)
